before: A tracked deletion over an equation committed, struck the text around it, and left the equation live.
after: A tracked deletion over an equation refuses before any operation commits. An equation inside the author's own pending insertion is removed, as their own text is.
reason: The refusal is local, so it produces no shared update. The removal inside the author's own insertion uses the existing node removal that peers already apply. Shared nodes, operation shapes, and package serialization remain unchanged.
